name: Tony_Shipment
_about: Spec v1.4 supplier portal. Delay_* = SP-R4 / SP-R5: the supplier reports a delay on its own copy. Prod_* = the Production screen: the server fills the view fields from the parent shipment (never a customer name or price); the supplier writes only Report_Prod_Event / Report_Prod_Date / Prod_Photo, and the server passes them to the parent shipment.

fields.name: Prod_Po_No
fields.label: PO No
fields.helpText: Server-written view field: the PO of this shipment.

fields.name: Prod_Lines
fields.label: Items
fields.helpText: Server-written view field: SKU, item and quantity, one per line. No customer, no price.

fields.name: Prod_Photo
fields.label: Production Photo
fields.helpText: JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP or PDF, 10 MB. Required before production finished can be reported (spec ST-R3).

fields.name: Report_Prod_Event
fields.label: Report Production
fields.helpText: Write-only: the server turns it into a stage event on the shipment and clears it.

fields.name: Report_Prod_Date
fields.label: Report Production: the day it happened
fields.helpText: Write-only. Blank = today. Never in the future.
